description: Agent Energy: submit a carbon credit or renewable certificate claim and the instruments behind it: the claim as made, read for absolute wording such as carbon neutral, net zero or 100% renewable, with the claimant, what backs it (carbon offsets or renewable energy certificates), the quantity and unit it covers, its period and when it was made; optionally the footprint it covers with its quantity, unit and basis; each instrument with its id, registry, serial, project, kind, vintage, quantity, unit, status (retired, active, cancelled, transferred or not known), when and for whom it was retired and any other party that claims it (an empty list when none); and optionally the most years a vintage may sit from the claim period (1 for certificates and 5 for offsets when left out). The signed report gives the claim with its wording, every instrument with its issues and whether it backs the claim, the coverage with the quantity claimed, the quantity retired behind it and the footprint, and counts them, and names an unbacked claim: no instrument, one not retired, retired for someone else, claimed by another party or listed twice, a retired total below the claimed quantity and absolute wording that reaches past what was retired; then an instrument in another unit than the claim, a vintage far from the claim period and a retirement after the claim was made, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. An untraced instrument and an unstated status, beneficiary, quantity, footprint or period leave the claim unverifiable. This reads one claim against its retirement records: sustainability claims against offered evidence are wever_environmental-evidence-check and a product claim against its evidence is wever_claim-evidence-check. Verdict energy_carbon_unbacked, energy_carbon_partial, energy_carbon_unverifiable or energy_carbon_backed. POST /api/energy-carbon-claim-check. Reads the energy records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Energy reads an energy customer’s own records and recomputes what they claim: the rate plan billed against the plan quoted, a solar or PPA proposal’s production and savings against its stated assumptions, a supply contract against what was agreed, a charging session against the posted price, a carbon credit or certificate claim against its retirement records, a utility bill against its tariff and usage, a commercial demand charge against interval usage and the tariff’s demand rules, and an equipment efficiency or savings claim against its rating and baseline. Beside it, wever_invoice-check reads any invoice against the job it belongs to and wever_fee-evidence-check a fee schedule against a quote or invoice, while an energy check recomputes energy charges from rates, usage and the tariff’s own rules; wever_contract-diff-check compares two versions of one text, while the contract check reads the signed contract against what was agreed; and wever_environmental-evidence-check reads sustainability claims against offered evidence, while the carbon claim check reads the retirement records behind one claim. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-energy-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-energy/.
